title: Но я же тебя учил
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one meme-inspired transparent static mascot sticker for a multilingual kanji learning app. Reference image specifies exact character identity and visual style, not pose. Keep the SAME round cream cat with large dark oval eyes, short cheek marks, pink inner ears and paw pads, fluffy curved tail, green student cap with broad curved brim, red band and round gold button. Preserve thick rounded dark forest-green outlines, cute proportions and simple flat matte colors. SCENE: A two-part sticker homage to Woman Yelling at a Cat. Two instances of the SAME mascot separated by empty transparent space, one compact horizontal scene. On the left cat points accusingly at a single cream flashcard with one simple abstract brush mark, mouth open in comic disbelief; on the right the same cat sits behind a tiny low table with the identical flashcard propped up in front, wearing a hilariously blank unbothered expression. Gentle funny exaggeration, no tears or cruelty. No people, plates or food. Center the whole scene in a square canvas with generous transparent safe margins. Anatomically correct cat, two forepaws and two hindpaws per cat, one tail. No text, readable lettering, flags, watermarks, sticker rim, glow, ground shadow, scenery or extra props beyond the scene. Genuine transparent alpha background: empty spaces transparent, dark outlines and facial features fully opaque.
